implementation.physiology: Per-patient predicted cine ED/ES selection, native-geometry soft volumes, physiology residual guards/weights, detached S4 cell-confidence weights, frozen-teacher extraction from image-only TRAIN U, SHA-sealed atomic cache, config/source/protocol/codebook binding, online refresh predicate, report-only DEV association diagnostic.
implementation.data: Protocol A reuses the student K-label set; Protocol B requires a separate all-TRAIN teacher label view. Both views verify cohort, native image identity and geometry. U frame metadata is restricted to patient/frame; sampler chooses L and U patients uniformly, samples a native frame within each, and serializes exact RNG and cohort state.
implementation.augmentation: Native y/x flips and spacing-gated in-plane quarter turns transform images and labels together while updating affine/spacing/shape. SDF is intentionally left to the caller to recompute from transformed labels. Labeled and U intensity views use deterministic gamma/noise generators; U teacher/student views share spatial geometry.
implementation.cache_cli: scripts/q3d_physio_cache.py verifies configured TRAIN manifest bytes and real post-T checkpoint SHA, requires an explicit loader for real runs, supports CPU synthetic-only construction, and does not train or access DEV/TEST.

coverage: analytic anisotropic ellipsoid volumes and predicted ED/ES
physiology guards, dataset switch and class-mapping inference
detached confidence cell weights and report-only DEV diagnostic
cache protocol/config/source/checkpoint identity, tamper detection and refresh
synthetic cache CLI with injected and default CPU teacher paths
image-only U cine traversal without mask reads
Protocol A/B label separation and deterministic resumable uniform sampler
world-coordinate exact flips/rot90 and anisotropic rotation rejection
shared U geometry and reproducible strong intensity view

remaining_integration_contract: Engine stage-P cache writes must pass config=config and source_identity=data.cache_source_identity(); physiology refresh must bind the refreshed teacher SHA and current source identity. No patient/GPU claim is made.
